answer: Each identity runs one echo-cancellation node in its own grove garden plot, locking a 70-credit bond with a registered signature. Each epoch, two auditors send a fresh echo probe and measure the residual at the plot: the node must cancel the echo there. One speaker cannot cancel sound at a thousand plots, so a rented-canceller ring fails the residual check and burns. Nodes interfere: the k-th node in the shared grove costs 32+8(k-1) to power, so the 1000th costs 8,024 and 1,000 fakes cost 4,028,000 plus 70,000 locked. An honest gardener pays 32 once and reclaims the bond after a clean epoch.
